topic: Code-Switching in End-to-End Automatic Speech Recognition: A Systematic Literature Review
topic_definition: Stage 1 observable projection of the original paper's eligibility. Use title and abstract evidence to judge whether the study concerns code-switching or code-mixing Automatic Speech Recognition, especially end-to-end or neural ASR systems.
summary: Stage 1 title/abstract projection of source-faithful Stage 2 criteria; publication-time filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2507.07741.json.

summary_topics.description: Code-Switching in End-to-End Automatic Speech Recognition: A Systematic Literature Review

required.criterion: Title/abstract indicates Automatic Speech Recognition or speech recognition.
Title/abstract indicates code-switching, code-mixing, codeswitching, or codemixing.
Observable system signal indicates end-to-end, E2E, neural, CTC, transducer, sequence-to-sequence, or similar ASR system work, or is plausible enough to defer E2E confirmation to Stage 2.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Title/abstract clearly indicates the paper is not about ASR or speech recognition.
Title/abstract clearly indicates the paper is not about code-switching or code-mixing.
Title/abstract clearly indicates a non-system paper outside end-to-end code-switching ASR, with no plausible ASR system contribution.
